decision_item.question: Approve the exact bounded short-path recovery-003 proposal as one authority envelope through sanitized terminal publication?
decision_item.reason: The failed manifest path is exactly at Esri's documented SAR path limit, while the manifest and orbit are otherwise recognized. The proposal tests the narrow path-length hypothesis without changing any source, orbit, DEM, AOI, grid, mask, threshold, registration, route, or scientific predicate.
decision_item.approval_effect: One approval covers packet and implementation publication, implementation and bounded corrections, portable and disposable ArcGIS-runtime tests, public CI, one final no-content preflight, at most one fresh real attempt, terminal reconciliation, and sanitized terminal publication with no intermediate owner reconfirmation.
decision_item.rejection_effect: No publication, implementation, ArcPy, external-custody access, copy, geoprocessing, or new attempt occurs.
